Hi Arthur,

Thanks for applying to the Software Engineer (Inference) role — really enjoyed the details in your submission. I’d love to do a short 20-minute phone screen next week to learn a bit about your background and share more about the role. Do any of the windows below work for you (times in GMT / my conversion to PST in parentheses)? If none, send me 2–3 slots that do and I’ll coordinate.

• Tue 11 Nov, 18:00–19:30 GMT (10:00–11:30 PST)

We typically do a 20-minute recruiter screen, then a technical take-home or an interview with Markus if we both think it’s worth the next step.
